poll.question: Wesley carries the night alone while Chills rests and Mutu keeps the panther at bay. Does this balance hold? Or does something shift tonight?

options.label: Keep the balance
options.desc: Wesley works, Chills rests, Mutu watches. It's working. Let it.

options.label: Rotate the watch
options.desc: Chills wakes. Wesley rests. You share the burden of night.

options.label: Face it together
options.desc: Pull Mutu in. Stay awake as three. The panther meets all of you.

in_play.label: Hunker down
in_play.desc: The fire's your anchor. Fortify it. Rest and recover here.
